description: The written-VAU exception observes its own named tail child and implies the complete KE tail pattern.
grammar:
%const $STAG-TAG @(tag) ∖ @(⋮ (FIhO ∪ free))
%const $KE-UNIT @(KE ⋯ KEhE [#])
%const $KE-SELBRI @([$STAG-TAG] $KE-UNIT)
%const $KE-GEK @([$STAG-TAG] KE [#] gek-sentence KEhE [#])
%const $KE-TAIL @($KE-SELBRI tail-terms) ∪ $KE-GEK
%const $WRITTEN-VAU @([terms] VAU≠"" [#])
%const $KE-TAIL-WITH-VAU @($KE-SELBRI (tail-terms ∩ $WRITTEN-VAU))

%rule text $t(other-candidate)
%conditions $t ≅ $KE-TAIL-WITH-VAU
%rule candidate selbri tail-terms
%rule selbri unit
%rule unit KE BRIVLA [+KEhE]
%rule tail-terms [terms] [+VAU]
%rule terms TERM
%rule other-candidate selbri other-tail
%rule other-tail [terms] [+VAU]
